title: Deterministic time is bounded-error randomized time
statement: For every time bound $T\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, every language decidable by a finite deterministic Turing machine in time at most a constant multiple of $T$ belongs to the class of languages decidable with bounded error in time at most a constant multiple of $T$.
